implementation_coverage.scope: Every exported input-sized Python implementation requires source-owned bounds; implemented public operations require their existing operation-owned growth proofs. Literal-only setup is proved from its source body. Unimplemented native operations remain unestablished and cannot be qualified by reference witnesses.
